title: Sweep: bridge prompt hardening (24 auditor prescriptions amortised)
summary: Bridge/prompt-delivery prescriptions: persona composition, tmux dispatch, prompt-body assembly. Amortised from 24 content-hash carryoverTodos that were unreachable by any operator directive: their ids were 32-char hashes, so goal-text could never name them and triage could not prioritise them (all 144 were stamped priority=high, which is the same as none being high). Queue audit 2026-08-27. Member prescriptions verbatim below; work them as one sweep, smallest-blast-radius first, and retire the group when the theme is clean.

prescriptions.text: PRESCRIPTION: go/internal/phases/audit/defect_ledger.go:757-765 — the inlined dispositionSchemaExample's DEFERRED entry carries a fully-formed reusable `reason` and is echoed straight into the failing agent's next prompt, while the DEFERRED branch at :672-678 checks only non-emptiness; replace it with a self-evidently non-reusable placeholder such as "<why THIS id is deferred — one sentence naming the id's defect>" while keeping id/status/evidence literal

PRESCRIPTION: In go/internal/tokenusage/fillpct.go, saturate or reject a negative/overflowed sum in PromptTokens and return FillPctUnmeasured from FillPct when promptTokens < 0; keep over-100% readings unclamped

PRESCRIPTION: Pass the peak-turn usage breakdown to FillWarnWithContributors when Result.PeakPromptTokens != 0, or label the appended figures explicitly as launch totals (contributors (launch totals, largest first)) so the percentage and the breakdown cannot be read as one scale
PRESCRIPTION: Drop the bare rate.?limit alternative from agy-tmux.json controls.usage.exhausted_regex (keep it in drift_probe_regex), mirroring the codex correction

PRESCRIPTION: Extend the agents/evolve-auditor.md:190 exemption clause to name the <!-- evolve-audit-chain --> block alongside acs-verdict.json / Ledger Entry JSON / AC-cite table — fold onto the existing line, the persona budget has one line of headroom (750/751)

PRESCRIPTION: Apply the same >=8-rune floor to the forward branch of pendingAtInputLine (driver_tmux_submitverify.go:88) so a short echo candidate cannot arm a re-send, and add a table row to TestPendingAtInputLine covering a sub-floor echo.

PRESCRIPTION: Add a settle between the prompt-delivery Enter (driver_tmux_repl.go:376) and the baseline capture at :531, or re-capture inside verifySubmitted before the first judgement, so a not-yet-redrawn pane cannot produce a spurious Enter.
PRESCRIPTION: Cover driver_tmux_submitverify.go:126 with a fixture whose CapturePane returns an error mid-resend-loop; the error is currently swallowed with no log line.
